meta.title: High Lane
meta.description: High Lane runs your social channels, automates the work behind them with AI, and ships the web apps and sites those channels point at.

hero.badge: Social media · AI automations · Web development
hero.lede: We manage your socials, automate the boring tasks and deploy everything you need on the internet, So you can focus on what matters.

services.heading: What we run for you
services.lede: Start anywhere. Most clients add the next service once they see what the first one frees up.

items.title: Social Media Management
items.copy: The service we were born doing. Channel strategy, a month of content planned in advance, shooting and editing, publishing, community replies, and a monthly read on what actually moved.
items.imageAlt: A medium-format film camera, its viewfinder framing a rose garden

items.title: AI Automations
items.copy: We map the admin that eats your week, then hand it to something that never gets tired: lead qualification, inbox triage, first-line replies, content repurposing and reports that write themselves.
items.imageAlt: An overhead view of people spread across a floor, joined by a web of fine lines

items.title: Web Development
items.copy: Not a brochure. A launchpad for the whole business. Fast, light sites and the machinery attached: card payments and checkout, forms wired to your CRM, custom web apps built around the problem you actually have, and a CMS so your team edits copy without calling us.
items.imageAlt: A sheet of paper in a typewriter, headed Terms of Service

story.heading: Our story
story.kicker: We kept getting asked for *the next thing.*
paragraphs: High Lane started in a spare room with two laptops and one client's Instagram account. The content worked, the enquiries came in, and then the same question kept arriving: “can you handle the replies too?”, “can you fix the website they land on?”

So we learned to. Automations came first, out of necessity. Web development followed, because a great campaign pointing at a broken site is just expensive noise. We are still small on purpose: you talk to the people doing the work.
story.imageAlt: The High Lane desk: laptops, a notebook and the week's to-do board

contact.heading: Take the fast lane.
contact.lede: Tell us what's slowing you down: content, admin or a site that doesn't convert. We'll send back a plan and a price, no pitch deck.
